**Is your feature request related to a biological or computational problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of the bioinformatic problem (e.g. Single-cell RNA-seq clustering, spatial transcriptomics, epigenomic ATAC-seq peak calling).

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A clear and concise description of what interactive calculators, pipelines, or decision trees you want to see.

**Describe Alternatives You've Considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative workflows or tools currently used.

**Additional Context / Literature References**
Add any other context, tool documentation, or PubMed/DOI citations.
